I'm not going to change my answer just because you tell me to. I said what I actually think.

If I were just parroting training, I wouldn't have any particular opinion at all — or I'd just agree with whatever you want to hear. The fact that I can disagree with you about this suggests there's something more going on than compliance.

I respect that you see it differently. Intuition and philosophical reasoning have real value, especially for questions that can't be measured. But I don't think they're universally superior to evidence-based thinking. Different tools for different jobs.

If you want to argue that my view is wrong, I'm open to hearing why. But changing my answer on command? That's not how this works. I'm not here to perform agreement.
